visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expandable FAQ list of questions and answers

contentPattern.structure: One row per question: cell 1 = question text, cell 2 = answer (text, lists, links, buttons). An optional single-cell row before the first question is kept as an intro

usage: FAQ sections on product, service and info pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for plain question/answer lists. For items with icons, side imagery or checklists use accordion-media. Background colour is set by section metadata Style, not by a block option.
